content.text: The 2004 World Championships records were found on the wayback machine archives. Only the single elimination bracket is accessible so only data on the top 32 finishers in each age division is preserved.
The archived standings page contained competitor names, countries, divisions, and tournament results. This information was used as the primary source for the 2007 database entries.

The 2005 World Championships actually has preserved full standings for each age division. I discovered these on the wayback archive after doing a deep search through hundreds of files and finding a workaround to load pages.
The archived standings page contained competitor names, countries, divisions, and tournament results. This information was used as the primary source for the 2005 database entries.
